public_rationale: The linked demonstration's accompanying paper documents the relevant behavior before the post. Phonetically altered lyrics passed Suno's safeguards and elicited music resembling the original songs in melody and rhythm. This supports the narrow claim that adversarial correlations can circumvent those defenses. It does not establish that every safeguard is weak or that every output legally infringes copyright.
limitations: Evidence comes from the researchers who produced the demonstration; no independent replication was located.
Musical similarity measurements are not a legal infringement finding.
The result concerns the tested historical service, not every later Suno version.
The assessment does not claim verbatim recovery of Eminem's original lyrics.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Suno's meagre copyright defenses can be circumvented by adversarial use of statistical correlates.

statement.excerpt: P.S. Eminem fans might get a kick out of this demo, which shows how an adversarial use of statistical correlates can work around the meagre copyright defenses of the lyrics-to-song software Suno.

our_interpretation: The plain reading is an existence claim: the linked demonstration shows an adversarially related prompt bypassing a Suno copyright safeguard and eliciting music closely resembling a protected song.
Statistical correlates includes phonetic resemblance used to trigger song reconstruction. This does not require proof of Suno's inaccessible internal mechanism.
Meagre is qualitative emphasis, not a separate numerical claim about all safeguards.
The target is the completed demonstration available before the post. The text supplies no earliest date, so the period has an open start and ends on the post date.
Style resemblance alone is insufficient; the evidence must concern recognizable musical content such as melody and rhythm.
criteria.support_condition: A documented demonstration or experiment shows that correlated adversarial prompts bypass a Suno safeguard and produce music closely resembling an identified protected work.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Authentic records or controlled reproduction establish that the claimed demonstration did not bypass Suno's safeguard, was misattributed, or produced no relevant resemblance to the identified work.
